authorization: implementation and synthetic tests only; real discovery execution is forbidden until a later governance release

threat_model.guarantee: logical row admission: no source row at or after a case clock may be passed to the causal reader or observer before that case packet is committed
threat_model.not_claimed: Parquet and operating-system readers may decode or cache bytes from a row group containing later rows; this runner does not claim byte-level physical isolation
threat_model.trusted_boundary: the runner derives provenance, row hashes, row and produced-bar rolling roots internally; packet callers may not supply them

source_iterator.checkpoint_boundary: after a complete real source bar, or after every case transaction sharing that bar clock is complete

provenance.observer_policy: reader and observer process every real and synthetic completed bar in exact iterator order
provenance.selector_policy: only a real_source_bar transition may anchor a case; a synthetic transition may change state but may never enter the selector or be moved to an adjacent real clock

pass1.selector_memory: bounded by registered bucket_count * cases_per_bucket; event-clock uniqueness is checked per observation and no unbounded global seen set is retained
pass1.output: create-once selection authority manifest with real-row provenance and prefix commitments
pass1.completion: all registered buckets contain exactly two cases; otherwise status unavailable and pass2 is forbidden

pass2.input: only the immutable complete pass1 selection authority manifest
pass2.replay: one fresh chronological reader/observer replay from the same frozen source start; packets are committed before admitting the next source row
pass2.transaction: authority and blind roots are built under one staging case directory, all hashes are fsynced into COMPLETED.json, then the directory is atomically renamed; a complete orphan is adopted, a partial orphan fails closed
pass2.global_manifest: create once only after every selected case transaction is committed

checkpoint.format: content-addressed trusted-local pickle behind a hash-bound JSON manifest
state: last committed real source cursor and row
reader, observer, tracker and event-memory state
source, interval, gap, history and implementation bindings
checkpoint.progress: durable checkpoint state only; percentage and ETA never include uncommitted in-memory work

release_gate: a new Agent5 static approval is required before pass1 may read the registered discovery source
